wc_bk_locked_intro: Your work is saved in your account. This makes a second copy on your own computer: the same files as Export all my work, closed with a passphrase. Only the passphrase opens it, so the file is safe to keep in email or a cloud drive.
wc_bk_locked_busy: Making your backup. This can take a moment.
wc_bk_need_unlock: Unlock your vault first, then make the backup again.
wc_bk_nocrypto: This browser cannot lock files here. Open the app at its https address, or use Export all my work.
wc_bk_fail: Could not make the backup. Check your connection and try again.
wc_bk_done: Locked backup downloaded. Keep the passphrase safe: it cannot be recovered.
wc_bk_check_intro: Choose a locked backup, or the zip from Export all my work. It is read here in your browser: nothing is sent anywhere and nothing in your account is changed. Checking one proves you can get your work back.
wc_bk_check_ok_locked: This locked backup opened with that passphrase and can be read: {n} document(s), about {w} words, saved {d}. Nothing in the app was changed.
wc_bk_check_bad: This backup file opened, but it is not complete. It holds {n} document(s), about {w} words, saved {d}. The problems are listed below.
wc_bk_prob_unreadable: Could not be opened when this backup was made, so the file holds no copy of it: {name}
wc_bk_check_v1: This file is from the old single-page Appuscholar, and Check cannot read it. To bring its documents into your account, close this window and use Import a v1 backup.
wc_bk_prob_stage: Some saved work of {name} could not be opened when this backup was made, so the file holds no copy of it.
wc_bk_rs_intro: Choose a locked backup, or the zip from Export all my work. The file is read here in your browser first, and nothing is added until you confirm.
wc_bk_rs_confirm: This backup holds {n} document(s), about {w} words, saved {d}. Restoring adds each project in it as a new project, with {suffix} after its title. Nothing you have now is changed or replaced.
wc_bk_rs_note: Restored documents are dated today. Earlier versions, Ready marks and the AI-use log are not in a backup, so they are not restored.
wc_bk_rs_problems: These parts of the file cannot be restored:
wc_bk_rs_busy: Restoring. This can take a moment. Keep this window open.
wc_bk_rs_cancelled: Unlock your vault first, then restore again. Nothing was added.
wc_bk_rs_ok: Restored. These new projects are in your project list:
wc_bk_rs_again: Restoring the same file again adds a second copy of what was made.
wc_bk_rs_f_stage: Some saved work of {name} could not be restored.
wc_bk_rs_f_rest: The rest of {name} was not tried, because saving stopped.
wc_bk_rs_f_skipped: {name} was not tried, because saving stopped.
wc_bk_rs_v1: This file is from the old single-page Appuscholar, and Restore cannot read it. To bring its documents into your account, close this window and use Import a v1 backup.
wc_bk_rs_fail: Could not restore that file. Check your connection and try again. Look in your project list first, in case part of it was added.
wc_bk_nudge_new: You have written {w} words and have not made a backup on this device yet. Your work is saved in your account; a backup is a second copy that is yours.
wc_bk_nudge_old: Your last backup on this device is {n} days old. Your work is saved in your account; a fresh backup keeps your second copy up to date.
